scope: logical selection and materialization only; no native KV or latency claims

failure_aware_saving_fraction.interpretation: target operating region, not a post-hoc success threshold

quality.discovery: zero point-estimate loss in official issue resolution versus the paired FULL control
quality.confirmation: zero point-estimate loss and lower 95% ordered-sequence-clustered quality-delta bound of at least -0.02
quality.claim_language: no observed accuracy loss; exact equality is not claimed from a finite cohort

secondary_constraints: no increase in unresolved submission or verification failures
saving remains positive under failure-aware accounting

session_modes.fresh_per_issue: one logical session identity per issue
session_modes.persistent: one logical session identity across the ordered issue sequence

sequence_strata.purpose: automatic session hygiene and cross-issue contamination control
measure retained architectural/localization knowledge and rediscovery avoidance
measure reuse when later issues consume artifacts or decisions from earlier issues
sequence_strata.expected_advantage_over_fresh: possible; fresh sessions require an explicit handoff

strategies.rationale: strong manual-reset efficiency and quality baseline
natural no-reset developer behavior and quality ceiling
automatic fresh-session equivalent inside a persistent session
strategies.failure_hypothesis: loses useful cross-issue state on related/dependent sequences

strategies.rationale: retain verbatim task plus minimal mutation, verification and completion state
strategies.failure_hypothesis: retained spines cost more than any rediscovery they prevent

strategies.rationale: preserve actions, provenance and control while compacting obsolete bulk observations
strategies.failure_hypothesis: stubs omit diagnostic facts or fail to pay for their visible tokens

strategies.rationale: retire only operationally obsolete completed-episode state with explicit witnesses
strategies.failure_hypothesis: certification coverage is too sparse for material saving

strategies.rationale: retain only completed episodes or records relevant to the active issue
strategies.failure_hypothesis: task-text similarity misses procedural or architectural dependencies

strategies.rationale: remove certified obsolete payload, pin control state, then retrieve uncertain prior evidence
strategies.configuration_rule: combine only nondominated parent settings; change one parameter at a time
strategies.primary_comparison: each parent and matched token tail
strategies.failure_hypothesis: component costs and redundant pins eliminate net saving

strategies.rationale: separate semantic-policy value from merely retaining the same number of recent tokens
strategies.configuration_rule: exact per-request materialized-token ceiling copied from candidate arm

strategies.rationale: upper bound on useful completed-episode memory
strategies.configuration_rule: leave-one-episode/record-out, pair removals, then bounded subset search

advancement.stage_1: run S00-S03 for N=1,2,3 on repeat-qualified sequences
advancement.stage_2: run each S04-S06 family alone on N=2,3
advancement.stage_3: stop dominated settings and combinations whose parents fail
advancement.stage_4: run S07 combinations only from nondominated parents
advancement.stage_5: expand nondominated profiles to N=4,5 and held-out sequences
advancement.quality_gate: zero point-estimate official-resolution loss in discovery and lower 95% ordered-sequence-clustered quality-delta bound at least -0.02 in confirmation
advancement.efficiency_gate: 30-50% failure-aware saving with no material successful-run calls-to-solution regression
advancement.subtarget_rule: settings below 30% saving may identify useful mechanisms or parents, but are not default-profile candidates
advancement.overshoot_rule: settings above 50% remain exploratory economy points unless they satisfy the same quality gate

uncertainty_unit: ordered issue sequence clustered; executions and requests are not independent
